Rear-Approach Alert System

Driver-Awareness Prototype

Our team is developing a prototype to alert drivers when another vehicle approaches quickly from behind.

Platform
Arduino-based electronics
Sensing
LIDAR distance measurements
Communication
NRF24 wireless modules
Interface
LCD display
Work in Progress

Prototype development in progress.

On This PageProject OverviewDevelopment & Testing
01 / Overview

Project Overview

The project began as a left-lane camping detector. We shifted the focus to using changes in measured distance to estimate approach speed and show a warning on the driver’s display.

02 / Testing

Development & Testing

Development and testing are ongoing. Detection performance has not yet been validated.
